lead: Competitive intelligence tracking across the rolling year reveals significant EFB and flight planning vendor activity, led by Jeppesen and Lufthansa Systems. Evidence demonstrates targeted customer adoption across major and regional airlines, including specific LCC wins.

insights.title: IFS Secures Multiple LCC and Regional EFB Adoptions
insights.finding: IFS expanded its EFBOne platform footprint by securing customer selections and deployments with fastjet, MY FREIGHTER (Centrum Air), and TUS Airways.
insights.aviation_context: fastjet is classified as an African low-cost carrier (LCC); MY FREIGHTER / Centrum Air is classified as an LCC; TUS Airways is classified as a hybrid/leisure carrier.
insights.caveat: Captured dates and announcements reflect reported agreement milestones rather than full operational rollouts.

insights.title: Aviobook Expands African Footprint with Royal Air Maroc Agreement
insights.finding: Thales subsidiary Aviobook signed a five-year agreement to supply Royal Air Maroc pilots with the AvioBook Flight EFB platform.
insights.aviation_context: Royal Air Maroc operates as a full-service flag carrier.
insights.caveat: Contract duration and scope are based on vendor-reported announcements.

insights.title: Jeppesen Integrates AI Foundation Model for On-Device ATC Transcription
insights.finding: Jeppesen announced the initial integration of Archer's ZEE aviation foundation model into ForeFlight Mobile EFB for real-time Air Traffic Control transcription.
insights.aviation_context: ForeFlight Mobile is a widely utilized Electronic Flight Bag platform in commercial and general aviation.
insights.caveat: The release notes describe the first phase of deployment.

insights.title: Lufthansa Systems Explores Strategic Sale of Core Aviation Software Units
insights.finding: Lufthansa Systems reportedly explored a divestment of its Lido and NetLine business units valued at approximately €1bn.
insights.aviation_context: Lido and NetLine provide essential flight planning, navigation, and operations control software to global airlines.
insights.caveat: Reporting is based on financial press coverage regarding potential M&A activity.

insights.title: Lufthansa Systems Launches Integrated NetLine One Offering
insights.finding: Lufthansa Systems launched NetLine One, an integrated software suite designed to unify airline planning and operational execution.
insights.aviation_context: NetLine software traditionally handles airline schedule planning, crew management, and operations control.
insights.caveat: Product launch details are derived from captured professional network and news feeds.
